 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Florida enters the tournament with a perfect 4-0 record after defeating Merrimack 83-54 on Friday. The defending SEC champions have been impressive on both ends of the floor, led by a talented frontcourt featuring Thomas Haugh, Alex Condon and Rueben Chinyelu. Haugh leads the Gators with 17.2 points per game, while Condon is averaging 12 points and 8.8 rebounds. Head coach Todd Golden will look to keep Florida's undefeated start intact as the Gators face one of their toughest early-season tests.
 Notre Dame has also opened the season 4-0 under head coach Micah Shrewsberry, most recently cruising past South Carolina State 99-59. Ethan Roberts leads the Fighting Irish with 19.8 points per game, while Brady Koehler is averaging 15.8 points and 6.8 rebounds. Gonzaga transfer Braeden Smith has provided excellent playmaking, averaging 7.3 assists per game. Notre Dame will look to pull off a major upset against the nation's top-ranked team and advance to the tournament semifinals.
